subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the comers while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. A sits in the middle of one of the sides. B sits third to the right of A. Only three people sit between B and H. C sits second to the left of H. D sits to the immediate right of G. E is not an immediate neighbour of B.

Who sits second to the left of F?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the comers while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

1) A sits in the middle of one of the sides.

2) B sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5e73a24434b5267fe2952568b19eaaeebedfe18ab4f6d8e3d12d68426e4c09f.png] 

3) Only three people sit between B and H.
